items.title: Avertismentul FMI pentru România: Reduceri de cheltuieli de 20 de miliarde de lei sau noi majorări de taxe

items.title: AirPods Pro 3 Drop to $169.99 in Amazon Black Friday Sale
items.snippet: Apple's AirPods Pro 3 have dropped to an even lower price today for Black Friday, available for $169.99 on Amazon, down from $249.00. items.line: AirPods Pro 3 hit all-time low of $169.99 during Black Friday, undercutting previous best prices by $10.

items.title: Companiile din România adoptă AI, dar pregătirea angajaților rămâne în urmă. Ce competențe vor conta tot mai mult pe piața muncii

items.title: Department of Labor moves to end expedited green cards for nurses, physical therapists
